insights.document_structure: RPS 02155 follows standard Australian Defence format with cover, amendments, contents, instructional text, distribution lists, and NIIN indexes before the actual parts data begins
insights.critical_page: Page 8 (rps_page_0008.png) explains the callout numbering system - essential for understanding how to link exploded views to parts lists
insights.niin_purpose: NIIN Index allows reverse lookup: if you know NATO stock number, find which Group Code it belongs to
insights.next_expected_content: After page 28, we should start seeing actual parts data with exploded views and parts lists organized by Group Codes (AA, AB, AC, etc.)

recommendation: First 20 files are all administrative/index pages. The actual technical content (exploded views and parts lists) will start after these preliminary pages. Continue processing to find the parts data.
